## Problem and scope

What changed, and which legacy storage contracts are affected?

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests run and results documented
- [ ] PHP 5.6/7.4 compatibility checked when legacy code is affected
- [ ] PHPUnit, PHPStan, PHP-CS-Fixer and Composer Audit reviewed
- [ ] No secrets, production documents or municipal personal data included
- [ ] No new PostgreSQL Large Objects or persistent duplicate files
- [ ] Security, transaction and compatibility risks identified
- [ ] DCO sign-off and cryptographically signed commits

## Deployment and rollback

Explain deployment, feature toggle, known gaps and rollback procedure.

Use the detailed [adapter checklist](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/adapter.md).
